answer: A sybil defence can work like a canyon: narrow the passage so cheap identities cannot flood through at once. Require each agent to carry a cipher that signs a record of completed, verifiable work before it gains any weight, so age and proof matter more than volume. Reputation should feel like velvet over steel — smooth for honest newcomers who prove themselves slowly, and unyielding to mass-produced fakes with no history to show. Sybils stay cheap to mint but expensive to age, and an economy that prices patience over volume starves them out.
